Ramoplanin (USAN, rINN) A-16686; MDL-62198; Ramoplanina; Ramoplanine; Ramoplani- num. Рамопланин CAS — 76168-82-6. Profile Ramoplanin is a glycopeptide antibiotic with a spectrum of ac- tivity in vitro similar to that of vancomycin (p.359) but consider- ably more potent. It is also active against Bacteroides spp. It is under investigation, notably for the treatment of Clostridium dif- ficile-associated diarrhoea. It has also been investigated for use in the prevention of systemic infection in patients colonised with vancomycin-resistant enterococci. ◊ Reviews. 1. Farver DK, et al.
